description:
Roll through your very own open house guided bicycle tour with a local real estate professional. As we pedal through marvels of health and wealth infused into Honolulu's fine beachfront neighborhoods. 
We drop in on select open-house properties that share the Aloha spirit of the Islands. We will walk through these homes and experience the beauty of these properties. Follow your experience with a delicious Hawaiian cuisine dinner on Sundays, 1:00 pm-5:30 pm.  This out-of-the-box experience includes professional photos, informative narration, inclusive meals, snacks, and hydration.
itinerary: We meet up at the famous Waikiki Kuhio Beach Hula Mound.  There, we roll out of Waikiki onto the Gold Coast of the Diamond Head neighborhood, where we check out affluent waterfront condominiums. We then roll around the back of Diamond Head on our electric (Stallons) Bikes, visiting a selection of homes known as the marvels of wealth of the Pacific. We finish this amazing experience with a local meal that is one part of our popular Hawaiian Foodie Bike Tour.
highlights: Tasting the wealth, seeing what could be, and learning about real estate from a professional guide with 44 years of Hawaii real estate experience.

faq_items.question: Why only Sunday afternoons?
faq_items.answer: This is the open house day for the public, 1-5 pm. We see between 6-10 properties during this experience.
